plan.rationale: Engaged visitors who read deep without clicking should meet the AI proof story ('The best AI is your AI') right under the hero instead of 4400px down. Flex promotion drifted sibling widths here, so the container is promoted to single-column grid, which stretches children like normal flow.

The intelligence/proof block moves to directly after the opening block. A front move would land above the 300px floor (the detected hero is zero-height), so it anchors after the first content block instead; grid promotion avoids the width drift flex caused.

The Ruggable customer case study lands directly after the hero, giving skeptical readers proof before the feature pitch. Flex promotion failed width checks on this 19-child main; single-column grid preserves block-flow widths.
'You're in great company' moves from 5200px down to right after the hero. Flex promotion changed section heights here (BFC formation); grid promotion keeps block-like flow.
